<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Found by the performance seat (governance roles/performance/memory/2026-11-06-spawn-attribution.md, file:line at f327a7d). Pre-existing since 03ab38e; not caused by s04. Doesn't gate the PEC try-out, so it sits behind the s05 critical path. Delivery (pij-swift-kestrel) owns claude_bind: if another coder takes this, kestrel reviews the bind change.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Two daemon launch sites go to zero at steady state: the per-pending-Claude-seat `/bin/date` for the UTC offset (#127, a per-tick-per-seat launch AGENTS.md forbids) and the per-ancestor `/bin/ps` in registration (#128). Both become in-process reads, each with a before and after counter reading and a spawn_sites guard.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

| ac-0001 | #127, UTC offset in-process. `crates/harnesses/src/proc.rs:322-327` computes the local UTC offset in-process (the time crate's local offset or libc localtime_r's tm_gmtoff) instead of launching `date`; every caller (claude_bind's loop at claude_bind.rs:73,90 from lib.rs:669-673, FYI claim and read, carrier flush, Claude adopt, revive, double-seat) gets the same value as before. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0001](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0002 | #128, ancestry in-process. `crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:1647-1662` reads each ancestor's pid, parent and command in-process (macOS proc_pidinfo or sysctl KERN_PROC; Linux /proc) instead of launching `/bin/ps`, keeping the 32-ancestor cap and the same results for native (:437) and paneless (:223) registration. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0002](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0003 | Guards. crates/testkit/tests/spawn_sites.rs fails if a `date` launch returns on the UTC-offset path or a `ps` launch returns on the registration ancestry path. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0003](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
